research_pack.summary: IIM Kashipur offers full-time residential MBA and MBA (Analytics) programmes, alongside Executive MBA and Executive MBA (Analytics) programmes. The MBA (Analytics) is a two-year, six-term residential programme featuring core management/analytics courses, electives, a summer internship, and a dissertation. The Executive MBA (Analytics) is a two-year, six-term blended learning programme for working professionals, requiring a bachelor's degree (min 45% marks) and 3 years of full-time work experience. Executive MBA fees total ₹12,00,000 over two years (₹6,60,000 for year one; ₹5,40,000 for year two). The institute facilitates student exchange programmes with various international partner universities. Admissions, selection criteria, and placement details are managed through the institute's academic and placement offices.

working at different levels, is an important constituent of the offerings at IIM Kashipur. These Management development programs(MDPs) are structured keeping in mind the changing global business environment and international standards which help in developing the skills and competencies of the participants. Our programs are designed for Specialised areas like business policy, finance, accounting, organisational behaviour, marketing, industrial and personal relations, quantitative and production methods, information systems and computers, health, public systems, agriculture and education. We offer two types of MDPs: Open MDPs: These programmes are in the nature of 'open-enrolment' courses, usually 2-5 days in duration with participation open to all practicing/experienced managers and/or executives. Customised MDPs: We also offer exclusive custom-designed programmes, to address specific Executive Learning and/or Corporate Training mandates from individual organisations. Under this format, courses are designed in collaboration with the client organisation, and scheduled at a mutually convenient date and venue. Such programmes can be domain-specific as in Sales & Marketing, Operations, Finance, Strategy, Leadership, etc. or inter-disciplinary, involving an optimal mix of multiple functional areas. Enter your details × Name: Email Moblie Number Organization ↻ The MBA (Analytics) at IIM Kashipur is a two-year, full-time residential program meticulously crafted to build a strong foundation in both management principles and advanced data analytics. Designed for future leaders in the analytics domain, the curriculum offers a structured and progressive learning journey that seamlessly integrates theoretical frameworks with practical application. First-Year Structure The first year is organized into three academic terms and comprises exclusively mandatory core courses. These courses span key functional areas of management and analytics, equipping students with essential knowledge and skills that serve as the bedrock for advanced study. Upon completion of the first-year coursework, students undertake an 8–10 week summer internship, providing immersive exposure to real-world business challenges and an opportunity to apply classroom learning in a professional environment. Second-Year Structure The second year is divided into three terms (IV, V, and VI) and features a blend of mandatory analytics courses, a diverse selection of electives, and a comprehensive dissertation component. Students have the flexibility to customize their academic path by selecting electives aligned with their interests and career goals. The dissertation, conducted across all three terms of the second year, allows students to engage in deep, independent research on a topic of personal or professional relevance. This capstone project fosters critical thinking and analytical rigor, guiding students through the process of problem definition, application of analytical methodologies, and synthesis of insights—skills that are indispensable in today’s data-centric business landscape. SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/admissions/mba/admissions-policy/
TITLE: Admissions Policy | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: MBA 2026-28 is IIM Nagpur's two-year full-time residential flagship programme. Batch size is 340 students. Admission is conducted in three stages: Stage 1 CAT 2025 eligibility screening; Stage 2 shortlisting for Personal Interview using CAT score and profile; Stage 3 final selection using Final Score. CAT 2025 minimum overall/sectional cut-offs: General 95/70/70/70; EWS 85/55/55/55; NC-OBC 85/55/55/55; SC 65/40/40/40; ST 40/30/30/30; DAP 40/25/25/25. Final Score weightage: CAT 45%, PI 25%, Past Academic Performance 6%, Work Experience 9%, Academic Diversity 5%, Gender Diversity 10%. Offer acceptance fee is Rs.1,00,000 and is adjusted towards Term I fees. The policy states that candidates must have positive scores in all CAT sections and that selection is category-wise based on Final Score.

SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/admissions/mba/fees-financial-aid-scholarship/
TITLE: Fees, Financial Aid & Scholarship | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: The total fee for the MBA 2026-28 programme is Rs.21,00,000. The fee payable at acceptance of the admission offer is Rs.1,00,000 and is adjusted towards the Term I fee. IIM Nagpur lists Merit Scholarship and Need-cum-Merit Scholarship schemes for MBA students; the published page states 10 Merit and 10 Need-cum-Merit scholarships and describes eligibility conditions.

SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/programmes/mba/about-mba/
TITLE: About MBA | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: IIM Nagpur describes the MBA as a two-year full-time residential Master in Business Administration programme, popularly known as PGP. The programme combines lectures, classroom discussions, case studies, individual and group projects, term papers, role plays and business games. It includes three terms a year, an international immersion after the first year, field immersion and a summer internship.

SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/programmes/mba/curriculum/
TITLE: Curriculum | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: IIM Nagpur states that its MBA curriculum is benchmarked against leading management institutes and uses lectures, case studies, projects, simulations and industry interaction. Areas and electives include Decision Science & Information Systems, Economics, Finance & Accounting, General Management, Marketing, Organizational Behaviour and HRM, Production & Operations, and Strategy & Entrepreneurship. Examples include Business Data Mining and Decision Models, Advance Analytics, Corporate Valuation, Financial Statement Analysis, FinTech, Investment Banking, B2B Marketing, Digital Marketing and E-commerce, Supply Chain Management, Operations Strategy, Management Consulting and Strategy in Action. Electives may change by academic year.

SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/programmes/mba/placements/placement-reports/final-placement-reports/
TITLE: Final Placement Reports | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: The official placement archive lists the Final Placement Report 2023-25, Audited Final Placement Report 2022-24, Audited Final Placement Report 2021-23 and earlier reports.

SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Finals-Report-2023-25_compressed-1.pdf
TITLE: Final Placement Report 2023-25 | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: For MBA 2023-25, 264 students participated. Average CTC was Rs.18,07,253 and median CTC was Rs.17,03,700. Highest CTC was Rs.69,57,000. Top 10% average was Rs.31,73,293; top 25% average Rs.25,14,420; top 50% average Rs.21,59,734. There were 89 new recruiters and 4 international offers. Nearly 58% of students opted for roles in Strategy & Consulting, Product Management, IT & Analytics and Sales & Marketing. Major sectors included BFSI, ITES, FMCG/FMCD, Consulting and Manufacturing.

SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Final-Placement-Report-2022-24-R28-June-1.pdf
TITLE: Final Placement Report 2022-24 | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: For MBA 2022-24, 255 students participated. Average CTC was Rs.16,29,241 (Rs.16.29 LPA) and median CTC was Rs.16,00,000. Highest CTC was Rs.38,40,000. Top 10% average was Rs.24,27,600; top 25% average Rs.22,04,189; top 50% average Rs.19,49,267. There were 62 new recruiters.

SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/IIM-Nagpur_Annual-Report-2022-23_Combined.pdf
TITLE: Annual Report 2022-23 | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: For MBA 2021-23, IIM Nagpur reported more than 100 participating firms. Average CTC rose 10.05% to Rs.16.74 LPA, median CTC was Rs.16.85 LPA and the highest offer was Rs.64 LPA. The institute reported strong participation from IT/ITES, BFSI and Consulting, with more than 70% of students opting for companies in those sectors.

SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/programmes/executive-mba-hybrid-at-nagpur-and-pune/about-executive-mba-hybrid/
TITLE: About Executive MBA (Hybrid) | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: IIM Nagpur's two-year Executive MBA programme in hybrid mode is designed for mid- to senior-level executives. Published eligibility requires working professionals with minimum 50% marks or equivalent in graduation and minimum 3 years of work experience.

SOURCE URL: https://www.iimnagpur.ac.in/programmes/blended-mba-for-working-professionals/about-blended-mba-for-working-professionals/
TITLE: About Blended MBA for Working Professionals | IIM Nagpur
CONTENT: IIM Nagpur offers a Blended MBA for Working Professionals designed for professionals seeking leadership, strategic decision-making and business-acumen development without disrupting their careers. The programme uses a blended format and integrates core management areas with emerging topics such as digital transformation, artificial intelligence and sustainability.

research_pack.summary: IIT Kanpur offers postgraduate management education primarily through the Department of Management Sciences, which provides M.Tech and PhD programmes. Admissions are conducted online via the institute's portal, with specific application windows (typically March-April for July semesters). Eligibility generally requires a relevant degree with a minimum 55% marks or 5.5 CPI (with relaxations for reserved categories). Selection processes vary by programme and may include academic performance review, GATE/JRF scores, and interviews. Financial support (Institute Assistantship) is available for non-sponsored students. The institute maintains a robust placement cell, reporting 672 job offers on Day 1 of the 2025-26 season. Fees and specific admission criteria are detailed in the institute's PG Manual and official admission brochures.

This represents a remarkable 16% increase over last year’s Day-1 placements, highlighting IIT Kanpur’s growing industry appeal and the strong demand for its graduates. With some results still pending, the count is expected to rise further. By the end of Day 1, 627 students had secured job offers, including Pre-Placement Offers (PPOs), reflecting a significant 20% rise in placements compared to the previous season. PPOs played a major role in this achievement, with 253 offers recorded, marking a strong 27% increase over last year. On the international front, nine students secured overseas offers, demonstrating IIT Kanpur’s global relevance. Top global and Indian recruiters actively engaged with students across disciplines, reaffirming IIT Kanpur’s reputation as a premier talent hub. Over 250 companies have shown interest in hiring IITK students this year. Leading recruiters include Accenture, BlackRock, HSBC, SAP, Airbus, PwC, Navi, Qualcomm, Deutsche Bank, and many more. The Students’ Placement Office and institute leadership congratulated all the selected students, expressed appreciation to the recruiting partners, and emphasised that this record-breaking Day 1 reflects the students’ dedication, the faculty’s mentorship, and the continued trust of the industry in IIT Kanpur. With several more companies scheduled to visit and many students yet to be placed, the 2025–26 placement season promises even more exciting career opportunities in the weeks ahead. ABOUT IIT KANPUR The Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, established in 1959 by an Act of Parliament, holds the distinction of being recognized as an Institute of National Importance by the Government of India. Renowned for its excellence in science and engineering education, IIT Kanpur has made significant contributions to research and development over the decades. Its expansive, lush green campus spans 1,055 acres and hosts a rich array of academic and research resources. The institute comprises 20 departments, 27 centres, three interdisciplinary programs, and three specialized schools across engineering, science, design, humanities, and management disciplines. With over 570 full-time faculty members and more than 9,500 students, IIT Kanpur remains a leader in fostering innovation and academic rigour.
